mastering.silence_trim: Leading -45 / trailing -50 dBFS raw, then -52 dBFS after gain/limiting preview to remove newly inaudible tails; 3–5 ms detection windows; retain 4/6 ms; reset timestamps; cap at requested duration
mastering.short_clip_handling: Trimmed clips shorter than 0.52 s gently slowed by resampling to 0.54 s; no silence padding
mastering.note: Duration is decoded audio; container duration can include MP3 framing. Final decoded MP3 RMS was gain-matched offline, without further API calls.

validation.result: PASS: all five MP3s decode, mono/44100 Hz; decoded and container durations 0.5–1.0 s; RMS within 0.5 dB of -24 dBFS; true peaks <= -9 dBTP; leading/trailing silence <= 30/40 ms at -55 dBFS
validation.tools: ffprobe; ffmpeg PCM RMS/sample-peak calculation, ebur128 true-peak, silencedetect

playback_intent: Quiet event-triggered one-shots for gas release, fire spell, barrier skill, wish grant and spell cast. No footsteps, music, loops or runtime changes; browser wiring/timing belongs to feature/delve-wave integration.

Start immediately and finish cleanly. No voice, speech, music, melody, footsteps, celebratory fanfare, sharp chimes, or long reverb.
